name: Hakone (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hakone town emblem in maroon: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain of two peaks.
history: Municipal flag of Hakone, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 February 1958.

features.role: Hakone town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain of two peaks
